propositions: An oversized ticket context (>24,000 chars) is refused by bounded recovery before any billable calls, blocking valid work from reaching closed status without --force-close.

A completion-verifier failure caused by step budget exhaustion incorrectly reports 'install the agents extra' remedy because recovery_failure_cause returns None for CompletionRecoveryError, which lacks the outcome attribute.
The criteria character budget (32,000) exceeds the context character budget (24,000), creating an incoherent bound where valid criteria sets can be rejected on context grounds.
Raising the context limit to 100,000 chars allows real blocked tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) to complete while preserving the per-criterion cost safeguard via elision-free pass-through.
Step-budget exhaustion failures must report their actual measured diagnostic (context_chars vs context_char_limit) rather than inheriting a generic missing-dependency message.
